commit.message:
Order lib.rs so it reads from top to bottom

No code changes: every line is where it was or moved as a block.

The message handlers already followed the sections of the paper, as the
doc comment on Message promises, but their helpers did not. The view
change handlers called into a block that sat 250 lines later, on the
far side of the recovery handlers and on_idle, and on_idle itself, the
second entry point, landed in the middle of the protocol logic with
most of what it calls still unread. The public accessors were split in
two, with view_number, the one every owner must persist, at the very
bottom after the private send helpers.

The Replica impl now reads: constructors, on_message, normal operation,
state transfer, view change, recovery, on_idle with its timer helpers,
log and commit helpers, send helpers, and the accessors in one block.
Each section's helpers follow its handlers. RecoveryResponse, a Replica
internal, moves down next to ClientEntry and ViewChangeVote instead of
sitting between the public message types and Client, and Config::new
now comes before the Default impl that calls it.
